name: search-hub
description: Search Hub CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `providers` domain: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the RegistryService proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: query
groups.description: Federated search across registered providers (router domain)

commands.name: query
commands.description: Search registered providers and return results grouped by provider

flags.name: type
flags.description: Comma-separated leaf types to route to (e.g. command,doc,record)

flags.name: all
flags.description: Fan out to every active provider

flags.name: group
flags.description: Scope the fan-out to one scenario's leaves

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Maximum results per provider

flags.name: explain
flags.description: Include the routing rationale (which selector chose the providers)

groups.name: providers
groups.description: Register, list, and remove federated search providers (registry domain)

commands.name: register
commands.description: Register (upsert) a provider descriptor

flags.name: descriptor
flags.description: ProviderDescriptor as JSON, or @path to a JSON file

commands.name: list
commands.description: List registered providers (optional filters)

flags.name: bucket
flags.description: Filter by routing bucket: DO|REUSE|KNOW|STATE

flags.name: type
flags.description: Filter by leaf type (command, doc, record, …)

flags.name: state
flags.description: Filter by state: active|capability_gap

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Deregister a provider by provider_id

groups.name: federation
groups.description: Federation status: per-provider reachability + classifier/reranker availability (routing domain)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show each active provider's reachability and whether the classifier/reranker models are available

groups.name: insights
groups.description: Federation telemetry insights: utilization, zero-result rate, latency percentiles (metrics domain)

commands.name: insights
commands.description: Aggregate per-query telemetry into federation-health signals (under-utilized providers, zero-result rate, p50/p95 latency)

flags.name: window
flags.description: Restrict aggregates to the last N days (0 or unset = all-time)

groups.name: metrics
groups.description: Declared analytical measures over search-hub query telemetry

commands.name: federated-latency
commands.description: P95 and p50 federated query latency in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: Federated search latency percentiles for search-hub in a time window.
questions: what is search hub federated query p95 latency this week
show federated search p50 and p95 latency in the last 30 days
how slow are search-hub federated queries this month

commands.name: degraded-query-rate
commands.description: Fraction of federated queries that degraded in a time window.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

measure.intent: Fraction of federated search queries that degraded in a time window.
questions: what fraction of search hub queries degraded this week
degraded federated query rate last month
how often did search-hub federation degrade in the last 7 days

commands.name: provider-degradation-rate
commands.description: Provider-leg degradation rate in a time window, optionally scoped to one provider.

flags.name: window
flags.description: Time window token (this_week, last_7d, last_30d, this_month, last_month, this_quarter).

flags.name: provider-id
flags.description: Optional provider_id to scope the rate, e.g. measures-health.measures.

measure.intent: Provider-leg degradation rate, optionally scoped to one provider id.
questions: how often does provider measures-health.measures degrade this week
provider degradation rate for swarm-manager.records in the last 30 days
which provider degradation rate is search hub seeing this month

groups.name: evals
groups.description: Register provider-owned golden suites and run them to baseline search quality over time (eval domain)

commands.name: register
commands.description: Register (upsert) an eval suite as JSON, or @path to a JSON file

flags.name: suite
flags.description: EvalSuite as JSON, or @path to a JSON file

commands.name: list
commands.description: List registered eval suites (optional --provider filter)

flags.name: provider
flags.description: Filter by provider_id (e.g. cli-health.commands)

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one eval suite by suite_id

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run an eval suite against its provider and store a tagged run

flags.name: tag
flags.description: Free-text experiment label stored with the run (e.g. rerank-off, cross-encoder)

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Per-case fetch depth (0 = a sensible default)

flags.name: assert
flags.description: Opt-in CI gate: exit non-zero if any case is below_expectation or unexpected_hit (the run is still stored)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Re-probe reviewed positive labels and classify expect_ids as live, hard, stale, or inconclusive

flags.name: deep-k
flags.description: Probe depth (0 = shared default)

commands.name: runs
commands.description: List a suite's run history (newest first; --tag/--limit filters)

positionals.name: suite_id
positionals.description: Suite id whose runs to list

flags.name: tag
flags.description: Filter to runs with this experiment tag

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Cap to the N most recent runs (0 = all)

commands.name: show-run
commands.description: Show one immutable eval run by run_id

positionals.name: run_id
positionals.description: Run id, e.g. a UUID returned by `evals run`

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare two eval runs (per-case outcome + score delta) — the A/B surface

commands.name: sweep
commands.description: Overfit-safe two-tier tuning sweep over a suite's provider; stores one tagged run per arm and (with --apply) writes back a statistically-significant, held-out-validated, constraint-satisfying winner

positionals.name: suite_id
positionals.description: Suite id to optimize, e.g. cli-health.commands.primary

flags.name: query-time-only
flags.description: Skip the reindex-per-arm index-time tier (cheap, full-factorial query-time only)

flags.name: apply
flags.description: Write the winning tuning back into the provider's search.json via config-write (default: preview only)

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Per-case fetch depth (0 = a sensible default)

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Grow a suite's golden corpus by sampling + inverting the provider's index (query inversion + hard negatives), de-duped against the existing corpus; preview by default, --apply appends

positionals.name: suite_id
positionals.description: Suite id to augment, e.g. cli-health.commands.primary

flags.name: count
flags.description: Target number of positive cases to propose (0 = a sensible default)

flags.name: negatives
flags.description: Also propose hard-negative (no-strong-hit) cases

flags.name: apply
flags.description: Append the proposals to the suite (each marked generated); default: preview only

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Promote reviewed candidate cases into the acceptance recall denominator

positionals.name: suite_id
positionals.description: Suite id to update, e.g. cli-health.commands.primary

flags.name: case
flags.description: Case id to promote; comma-separate multiple ids

flags.name: all
flags.description: Promote every candidate case in the suite

groups.name: maturity
groups.description: Scan target scenario search maturity using Search Hub validation

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scan every scenario with .vrooli/search.json and report search maturity findings

flags.name: root
flags.description: Repo root or descendant path; scanner walks up to find scenarios/

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Per-scenario validation RPC timeout, e.g. 10s or 1m

flags.name: fast
flags.description: Skip live eval evidence checks for a quick descriptor/state scan

flags.name: include-evals
flags.description: Force full eval evidence checks; this is the default unless --fast is set

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Preview or apply safe mechanical .vrooli/search.json maturity fixes for one scenario

flags.name: path
flags.description: Optional explicit scenario path; useful for disposable fixtures

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Comma-separated finding codes to fix; empty previews every safe mechanical fix

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Fix RPC timeout, e.g. 10s or 1m

flags.name: apply
flags.description: Write the previewed mechanical fixes; default is dry-run

domains.reason: query_telemetry and query_telemetry_provider are persisted, countable telemetry substrates for federated search latency and degradation measures.
